The Supreme Court confirmed what we all know, that Joe Biden’s vaccine mandate for private sector companies is blatantly unconstitutional. 
https://t.co/5jM1EfFvNK

Healthcare costs will cripple our ability to have a secure retirement if we continue down the same spending path we’ve been on. Let’s stop using subsidies to manage healthcare costs and start using technology to get rid of them. https://t.co/D7afZDrFoW

As co-chair of the Congressional Telehealth Caucus, I am excited to share that Medicare beneficiaries’ access to telehealth will extend beyond the COVID-19 emergency period.  My colleagues and I have worked tirelessly to protect patient access to the care they want and deserve. https://t.co/AO6bLPAv0j
While there is still more work ahead to make healthcare accessible and improve outcomes across the board, I am proud to secure these Telehealth wins for our country.

I questioned @SecBecerra today on the fentanyl epidemic, cutting costs in healthcare, and utilizing telehealth effectively. We can do more to address these issues, but it takes a willing Administration to make it happen. https://t.co/BoC3wsl42p

Today, I joined @thehill to discuss ways to crash the cost of healthcare for all Americans. We need to change the conversation and focus on revamping the finance mechanisms that have caused so much misery.

Unless we get serious about real reform, the cost of Medicare and Medicaid will rise by $1 trillion in 10 years. 

Combined with interest, we’re looking at a structural deficit of $2 trillion in the next decade. 

This week’s floor speech ⬇️
https://t.co/i0fhZBwUBb

President Biden used his State of the Union address to falsely accuse Republicans of wanting to cut Social Security and Medicare. 

I dispelled this myth in my weekly floor speech last night. 

Watch here ⬇️
https://t.co/TrtuPqqT6O

🚨CBO’s new projections are frightening🚨

-$1.4T deficit in FY23
-National debt nearly doubling to $46T by 2033 (+118% of GDP)
-Medicare and Social Security trust funds exhausted
-Interest costs over $1T

The math always wins.

The Biden administration is lying again. 

My @HouseGOP colleagues and I have no intention of cutting Social Security and Medicare. 

We have solutions ⬇️

https://t.co/iYixSv5md7

Ever since his State of the Union address, President Biden has made it toxic to discuss viable solutions to save Social Security and Medicare. 

Despite what Democrats say, @HouseGOP has been working tirelessly to protect and preserve hardworking Americans' retirement benefits. https://t.co/1LP5mj38xS

Joined @AZMorningNews today to discuss the scale of our national debt.

Our government has functionally become an insurance company with an army — and the costs are beginning to skyrocket. https://t.co/gvN7frbPcu

🚨 REMINDER: Medicare Open Enrollment ends December 7. If you or a loved one are interested in enrolling in Medicare or changing which plan you’re covered under, make sure to do it by this Thursday at https://t.co/d9VVHTb0Lg! https://t.co/P2vDiYTQUr

So far this fiscal year (3 months in), the total national debt has increased by $839 billion. That's ~$8.65 billion per day, and just over $100,000 per second.

I implore my brothers and sisters in Congress to take our nation's fiscal health seriously. https://t.co/7XACzQ0mjM

On Friday, my staff attended the Vietnam Veteran Pinning Ceremony at the Carl T. Hayden VA Medical Center to recognize our veterans from the Vietnam War. We were proud to honor these heroes for their selfless service and sacrifice in defense of our great nation. https://t.co/PzsSbClUZT
Our nation’s fiscal health is deteriorating very, very quickly. We cannot continue to allow deficits to skyrocket out of control.

Debt held by the public just passed $27 TRILLION ‼️

Another grim milestone.

Our nation’s fiscal health is deteriorating right before our eyes. https://t.co/YfamApW1jk

Will my brothers and sisters on the Left ever put batteries in their calculators?

Every dime that Congress votes on is borrowed. Drastic change is needed to restore our fiscal health.

The national debt will have increased by over $333 million by the time President Biden finishes speaking.

Our nation’s fiscal health is rapidly deteriorating.

🚨 Alarming stat — 39¢ out of every dollar paid in individual income taxes in the first half of this fiscal year ONLY covered net interest payments.

How much longer will we allow our fiscal health to go off the rails? https://t.co/cHjpk2aTcl

Embracing telehealth is one of the most moral actions we can take to expand patient access to health care providers.

I’m pleased that @WaysandMeansGOP unanimously advanced this bipartisan legislation & I’ll continue working with @RepThompson to pass this bill through the House.

In just the last few weeks, at least four wildfires (Wildcat, Spring, Adams, and Catahoula) have started in our district. I encourage everyone to please exercise caution with fire or anything that can cause fires when outside enjoying Arizona’s beautiful wilderness.

Artificial Intelligence is leading the charge during this health care revolution. I thank @WaysandMeansGOP Vice Chair @VernBuchanan for including my“Maintaining Innovation and Safe Technology Act” in this bill to emphasize the importance of innovation in our health care system.

I had the opportunity to sit down with Host Heather Howard and Prof. Niraj Jha on the Princeton Pulse Podcast to discuss the ways in which AI integration into our health care system promotes morality.
 
You can listen to the full conversation on any streaming platform. https://t.co/mS2ac1mR7z

There are ways to promote the health and wellness of our brothers and sisters. And it’s not partisan, it’s moral. 

It’s crucial we enact policies that  embrace disruption, as opposed to engaging in political theatrics.
